**STEP 1 - Scene:** An airline-style meal tray photographed from the front at a slight downward angle. It holds baked cannelloni in tomato-meat sauce, a mixed vegetable bowl, a fruit bowl, a glass of juice, and a glass of water.

**STEP 4 - Area:** Cannelloni covers about 25% of the plate (about 78 cm²). Vegetables fill about 60% of their bowl (about 68 cm²). Fruit fills about 70% of its bowl (about 108 cm²).
